name: Analyze
description: Analyze a new issue, internally review the plan for gaps, and update the issue description with a grounded implementation approach. Triggered on GitHub issues.opened.

workflows.name: Analyze
workflows.description: Reads a freshly opened issue, inspects the source code, reviews the analysis for gaps, and updates the issue body with a marked Conduit analysis section.

nodes.name: Review
nodes.instructionsAppend: Do not post to the connected platform from this node — the downstream Publish agent handles all platform updates.

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.instructionsAppend: Update the source issue body with a marker-bracketed analysis section. Preserve the user's original content. Add or replace only the section between <!-- conduit-analysis:start --> and <!-- conduit-analysis:end --> markers. The section should contain a concise summary, proposed approach, likely files or areas, tests to run, and risks or open questions. Do not post a normal comment.
